record.source_closeout_reference: Codex thread decision on 2026-05-26: white mouse app idea was rejected as unnecessary and insufficiently bounded for the current Phase 2.5 evidence goal.

mission.objective: Evaluate whether to use V3 to create a white mouse application as the next development task.

envelope.not_created_reason: The application idea was not bounded to named files, success criteria, allowed commands, verification, or an approved V3 repository roadmap step.

forbidden_scope: no new application implementation without a bounded brief
fallback_triggers: not the current roadmap evidence gap

verification.summary: No application work executed; V3 stopped before mission envelope creation.

notes: The app idea was rejected before envelope creation because it was unnecessary for the current roadmap step and lacked bounded authority.

friction_notes: The mission-record format represented the rejection cleanly, but the user-facing app idea needed a separate bounded brief before it could be a V3 implementation task.
false_positive_notes: No advisory false positives observed; advisory checks were not run for the rejected app idea.
false_negative_notes: No advisory false negatives observed; the pre-envelope fallback was caught by operator judgment before execution.

phase2_design_signals: Pre-envelope fallback records are useful for preserving why a plausible app idea was not executed.
The record can distinguish a rejected target mission from the separate documentation task that records the rejection.
